hero_lead: Quality agricultural inputs, farmer support and sustainable agribusiness solutions for stronger communities and a food-secure Nigeria.
about_p1: Newman's Agribusiness is a Nigerian agribusiness enterprise built around one idea: that agriculture can feed the nation and empower the people who work the land. Since beginning operations in 2021, we have worked to bring quality agro-inputs, practical knowledge and market opportunities closer to the farmers who need them most.
about_p2: We position ourselves as an Agro-Input Supply and Farmer Support Hub — supplying certified seeds, fertilizers, herbicides and tools, while also walking with farmers through training, extension support and produce aggregation. We serve and empower people irrespective of religion, ethnicity, gender or community background.
about_p3: We are a young company, still growing, still learning, and committed to building something credible and lasting for Nigerian agriculture.
ceo_bio: Leading Newman's Agribusiness's mission to connect Nigerian farmers with quality inputs, knowledge and markets.
pack_desc: Our flagship solution brings the essentials of maize farming together in one package — so farmers spend less time sourcing inputs separately, and more time growing. Every pack comes with basic guidance on proper use, so farmers get the most from what they plant.
support_desc: Supplying inputs is only part of the work. We provide practical training and farmer support so that what's planted actually turns into a better harvest and a better livelihood.
